scientific_scope: Source-only reconnaissance for Deribit BTC DVOL futures term-structure/convergence research. This is a new mechanism family and is not a rescue or substitute execution of BTC-OPTIONS-VRP-001.
economic_mechanism: DVOL futures are linear futures on the BTC DVOL implied-volatility index and settle to a TWAP of DVOL. A future study may test futures-vs-index basis/term-structure convergence, but no outcome or trading rule is authorized in this source gate.
primary_source: Deribit official history API / official instrument metadata
source_only_questions: Can historical BTC DVOL futures instruments be identified prospectively from official Deribit data?
Can bounded historical public trade tape be recovered for multiple fixed 2023-2024 probe windows?
Do recovered records contain instrument_name, timestamp, price, amount, direction, index_price and mark_price where applicable?
Can creation/expiration/settlement metadata be recovered for the exact discovered instruments?
Is historical trade density sufficient to justify freezing a separate discovery MVE before opening any convergence outcomes?
